original_question: Sandra, mai sayar da furanni a kusa da kwanar, ba ta jin daɗi da rashin cikar oda idan aka sa ga Fred . Sandra ta ba da oda ninki sau huɗu na jajayen fure sama da na fararen carnations. Ta kuma umarci lilies masu ruwan hoda guda 200, wanda ya ninka adadin farar carnations sau biyar. Sandra ta yi barazanar sauya masu kaya idan ba a kawo jajayen furen da suka bace da karfe 5 na yamma ba. Don ci gaba da kasuwancin Sandra, jajayen fure nawa ne Fred zai kawo da misalin karfe 5 na yamma?
